description: Qualifying investment thresholds for Turkish citizenship under Law No. 5901 Art. 12(1)(b) and Art. 20 of the implementing Regulation.

current.label: Real estate
current.basis: Official SPK-licensed appraisal value, not the contract price
current.annotation: Three-year no-sale annotation recorded on the title deed (tapu)
current.conversionNote: Art. 20(10) names sub-paragraph (b): the foreign currency is sold to a bank operating in Turkiye and by that bank to the Central Bank before the transaction. The paragraph does not say in what form the proceeds are then held, because they pay for the property.

current.label: Bank deposit
current.basis: Turkish lira deposit in a bank operating in Turkiye, after the foreign currency is sold to the bank and by the bank to the Central Bank (Regulation Art. 20(10), since 6 January 2022)
current.conversionNote: Art. 20(10) names sub-paragraph (ç): the foreign currency is sold to a bank operating in Turkiye and by that bank to the Central Bank, and the lira proceeds are held in a Turkish lira deposit for three years. The deposit is a lira deposit, not a foreign currency deposit or a choice between the two.

current.label: Government bonds
current.basis: Certified by the Ministry of Treasury and Finance
current.conversionNote: Art. 20(10) names sub-paragraph (d): the foreign currency is sold to a bank operating in Turkiye and by that bank to the Central Bank, and the lira proceeds are held in lira-denominated government debt instruments for three years.

current.label: Investment fund shares
current.basis: Real-estate or venture capital fund shares (GYF/GSYF)
current.conversionNote: Art. 20(10) names sub-paragraph (e): the foreign currency is sold to a bank operating in Turkiye and by that bank to the Central Bank before the transaction. The paragraph's second sentence, on how the lira proceeds are held, does not mention (e).

current.label: Fixed capital investment
current.basis: Certified by the Ministry of Industry and Technology
current.conversionNote: Art. 20(10) does not name sub-paragraph (a), so the lira-conversion rule does not apply to fixed capital investment.

current.label: Private pension contribution
current.basis: Contribution to a private pension (BES) held in funds determined by the Insurance and Private Pension Regulation and Supervision Agency (SEDDK), which also certifies that the contribution was made
current.holdingNote: Three years in the private pension system, running from the date the lira equivalent reaches the company's accounts rather than from the contract date.
current.conversionNote: Art. 20(10) names sub-paragraph (f): the foreign currency is sold to a bank operating in Turkiye and by that bank to the Central Bank, and the lira proceeds are held for three years in the funds within the private pension system determined by SEDDK. The last sentence of Art. 20(10) leaves the application rules to the Central Bank; those rules are not restated here.
notes: A later fall in the accumulated balance below USD 500,000 caused by exchange-rate movement does not of itself affect the application.
The contribution may not be split across more than one pension contract.

The 30 per cent state contribution to private pensions does not apply, because Additional Article 1 of Law No. 4632 requires the participant to be a Turkish citizen and the foreign investor is not one at the time of the contribution.

current.label: Job creation
current.basis: Certified by the Ministry of Labour and Social Security
current.conversionNote: Art. 20(10) does not name sub-paragraph (c), which is a number of employees and not an amount of currency.

familyInclusion.childrenOver18Rule: Not a yes-or-no field. Law No. 5901 Art. 12(1)(b) names the minor or dependent foreign children of the investor and of the spouse, so a child aged 18 or over is within the text if dependent. The statute does not define dependency; it is assessed file by file. Earlier releases gave false here, which the statutory wording does not support.
familyInclusion.statutoryWording: Law No. 5901 Art. 12(1)(b): "bunların yabancı eşi, kendisinin ve eşinin ergin olmayan veya bağımlı yabancı çocuğu"
familyInclusion.note: Age is assessed at the application date, not at the decision date.

requirements.currencyConversionCertificate: Mandatory (doviz alim belgesi); funds must move through the Turkish banking system
